reset.all: Each reset pin to its own SWD pin10; one10k RMCF0805FT10K0 pullup to3V3_SYS each. No reset button or CBUS recovery.
reset.GW: 100nF KGM21NR71E104KT reset-toGND perDS12288 Fig27. PreserveNRST_MODE reset behavior.
reset.SAM: 10nF CL21B103KBANNNC each reset-toGND, engineering filtering choice within conventional reset circuit. Manufacturer says externalpull optional; no noisy-environment qualification claimed.

support.boot: GWpad61PB8-BOOT0 one10k RMCF0805FT10K0 toGND. FirstSWDprogramming with peersdisconnected; reviewoptionbytes andapplication-safePHYdefaults.
support.swd: EachSAMpad45SWCLK one10k RMCF0805FT10K0 pullup to3V3_SYS. DS60001479J Table53-7p1182 permits10-50k. STM32 usesinternalSWDpulls. NoextraSWDseries orcap.
support.timing_series: One330CRGP0805F330R from each *_MCU signal tocorrespondingheadernet; privateRX/TX/EVENTandsharedSYNC/TRIG.24total. SharedSYNC/TRIG10kpulldown eachatheaderside, nointernalpulldowns needed.
support.GW_supply: DirectSYS pins1VBAT,16/32/48/64VDD,28VREF+,29VDDA. GND15/27/31/47/63. Six100n maincaps(4VDD+VBAT+VREF),1u sharedVDDA/VREF,10nVDDA,4.7udigitalbulk. VREFBUFdisabled/highZ. NoVCAP pin.
support.SAM_supply: EachSYS pins6VDDANA,17/36VDDIO,44VDDIN withfour100n plusone1ulocalbulk. Ground5/18/35/42. Corepin43 separatelyone1u +100n toGND; neverjoincoresorSYS.
support.crystals: Four12MHzECS-120-20-3X-EN-TR, each33pF CC0805FRNPO9BN330 toGND bothends. GWpins5/6, SAM23/24. Noaddedfeedback/seriesresistor. Acceptedinitialloadvalues; startup/drive/loadedfrequencybringupcheck.
support.debug_defaults: InternalRXpullup in firmware adequate forshortbench debug cables; keep externaldriverhighimpedancewhenmainoff. Noextrasupportorprotection inferred.
